project.title: Heritage Short: The Patience of Buna

render_targets.note: Suggested sizes (multiples of 16). Keep every key subject inside the central 50% of the frame so one still crops cleanly to both 16:9 and 9:16.

project.style_block: Cinematic documentary, 35mm anamorphic film look with fine grain and gentle halation. Dim Addis Ababa family living room on a rainy Kiremt afternoon: warm crimson charcoal-ember uplight against cool blue-grey window light. Floor spread with fresh green ketema grass dotted with small yellow daisies; low wooden barchuma stools; a tall woven straw mesob; a small clay incense burner (etan) with a thin thread of frankincense smoke; a low wooden rekebot cup stand. Coffee set: wide shallow black sheet-iron roasting pan (biret mitad / menkeshkesh) with a long iron handle, resting on a low terracotta charcoal stove (furnello) full of glowing embers; hand-forged black iron hook stirrer; black round-bottomed clay jebena with a bulbous body, long slender neck, side handle and a small twisted-straw stopper; small handleless white porcelain sini cups. Photorealistic dark skin tones, natural skin texture.
project.style_block_short: 35mm anamorphic documentary film look, dim Addis Ababa home interior on a rainy afternoon, crimson charcoal-ember glow against cool grey window light, fresh green grass on the floor, fine film grain, shallow depth of field, photorealistic dark skin tones
project.character_bible: Mother (Emaye): Ethiopian woman in her late 40s, rich warm dark-brown skin, high cheekbones, almond-shaped dark eyes, fine smile lines, serene maternal expression. Hair in neat traditional shuruba cornrows. Handwoven white cotton Habesha Kemis, ankle-length with soft draped folds, with a green-and-gold tilet embroidered neckline and matching border at cuffs and hem; a thin white cotton netela shawl occasionally over one shoulder; small gold stud earrings. Son: slender 15-year-old Ethiopian boy, warm golden-brown skin with the same warm undertone as his mother, the same high cheekbones and almond dark eyes, thick defined eyebrows, voluminous textured coily black hair styled upward in a natural crown, casual heather-grey pullover hoodie, thin black cord necklace, patient and eager expression. Adult Son (shot_09 only): the same boy grown up to about 32 - same eyes, eyebrows and smile, short neat coily black hair, light stubble, heather-grey knit sweater echoing the childhood hoodie, same thin black cord necklace.

set_geography.note: Keep screen direction consistent across all interior shots so the mother and son read as sitting opposite each other (180-degree rule). Shot_04 is the only two-shot and shows this whole layout in one frame.
set_geography.layout: The charcoal stove is at the center of the room. The mother sits on a low stool at screen-LEFT of the stove, with the rain-streaked window directly behind her. The boy sits on a barchuma stool at screen-RIGHT of the stove. The rekebot cup stand, jebena and incense burner are on the grass beside the stove.
set_geography.eyelines: The boy looks screen-LEFT toward his mother and the stove (shot_04). The mother looks screen-RIGHT toward her son (shot_05, shot_07).
set_geography.light_direction: Ember light always comes from the stove at the center of the room: from the left side of frame on the boy, from the right side of frame on the mother. Cool rain-grey light comes from the window behind the mother.

props_glossary.look: Freshly cut, bright green blades spread loosely over the floor, often with small yellow daisies scattered in it.
Small clay or wooden burner with a thin, pale thread of frankincense or myrrh smoke. This smoke is thinner and bluer than the thick white roasting smoke.
Wide, shallow black iron pan with a LONG handle that keeps the hand away from the heat. Beans are shaken or stirred with an iron rod.
Low terracotta stove holding glowing charcoal with a bright crimson-orange core and grey ash on top.
Black round-bottomed clay pot, about 25-40 cm tall, bulbous body, long slender neck, small spout, side handle, a small twisted-straw stopper in the neck. Never a conical lid.
Tiny handleless cups, about the size of an espresso cup, usually white porcelain, set in a row on the rekebot.
Low wooden stand or tray that holds the sini cups, set on a bed of grass.
Heavy wooden mortar bowl and a long blunt wooden or iron pestle, used to grind roasted beans.
Small bowl of popcorn or roasted barley kolo served with the coffee.
Ankle-length handwoven white cotton dress (shemma ሸማ). Tilet (ጥለት) woven or embroidered borders run along the neckline, cuffs and hem. Often paired with a thin white netela shawl.
The three rounds of coffee: strongest, weaker, then the 'blessing' round. Shot_08 is abol, the first and darkest pour.

music.caption: Acoustic Ethiopian meditative melody featuring delicate Masenqo and Krar motifs, subtle rain ambient Foley, warm cello swells, slow contemplative pacing.

generation_notes: FLUX.1 schnell: use 4 steps, guidance 0, and keep every image_prompt under about 170 words. Its text encoder is capped at 256 tokens and anything past that is silently cut.
FLUX.1 schnell has no negative prompt. Do not write 'no X' inside an image prompt because it can add X. Use the negative_prompt_video fields with Wan 2.2 only.
FLUX weighs early tokens more, so each image_prompt opens with shot type and subject, then details, then lighting and style.

Every image_prompt is self-contained. Do NOT also prepend style_block and character_bible, because that would push the shot text past 256 tokens. If your script prepends anything, use style_block_short and character_tokens instead.

A fixed seed does not keep a face the same across different prompts. For identity consistency, generate the character_sheet_prompts first and use them as reference images (reference-image or LoRA step), then reuse the exact character_tokens string in every shot.

Wan 2.2 image-to-video already sees the still, so motion_prompt describes only movement: subject action, camera move, environment, speed. Target about 5 seconds per clip; use ken_burns_motion or a slow-down to cover longer narration.

To keep an unwanted extra person (for example a small child) out of a FLUX frame, state the exact head-count in the first words of the image_prompt ('exactly two people') and avoid the words 'child' or 'kid' in it; FLUX has no negative prompt to remove them.
project.end_card_text: Created with AI-assisted generative tools (Gemini Speech, FLUX.1 schnell, Wan 2.2) honoring Ethiopian oral heritage and family cultural memory.

shots.image_prompt: Medium two-shot of exactly two people, mother and teenage son, facing each other across a low clay charcoal stove, dim Addis Ababa living room, rainy afternoon. On the left, on a low stool: Ethiopian mother in her late 40s, rich warm dark-brown skin, high cheekbones, almond dark eyes, neat shuruba cornrows, white handwoven cotton habesha kemis with green-and-gold tilet embroidered neckline, calmly roasting pale yellow-green coffee beans in a long-handled black iron pan over crimson embers, stirring with a hooked iron rod, eyes on the pan, thin white smoke rising. Foreground on green grass: a wooden rekebot tray with a row of small empty handleless white porcelain sini cups beside a black clay jebena with a straw stopper. shots.motion_prompt: The mother slowly stirs the beans in lazy circles with the hooked iron rod and gives the pan a gentle shake by its long handle, the pale beans tumbling and thin white smoke curling upward; she keeps her eyes on the pan with a faint, patient smile. Across the stove the boy leans further forward on his stool, glances from the pan up to his mother and back, shifts restlessly and lets out a small impatient breath, mouth mostly closed. Embers pulse softly, rain trickles down the window behind her, the empty cups in the foreground stay still. The camera makes a slow, subtle push-in toward the stove between them, stable framing. shots.image_prompt: Wide shot of an adult Ethiopian man in his early 30s, the same boy grown up: warm golden-brown skin, high cheekbones, almond dark eyes, thick eyebrows, short neat coily black hair, heather-grey knit sweater, thin black cord necklace.
